claim_text: This year we achieved ~17% reduction in greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, supported by renewable energy use, operational efficiencies and technology partnerships.
metric_name: Total Scope 1 and 2 emissions reduction against FY20 baseline
context_text: This year we achieved ~17% reduction in greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, supported by renewable energy use, operational efficiencies and technology partnerships.；In FY25, our total Scope 1 and 2 emissions ... achieving a reduction of 17% from the FY20 baseline, predominantly attributed to the Cowal and Northparkes PPAs.；This reduction was driven by the continued contribution of the Cowal PPA ... as well as the introduction of a new, similar PPA for Northparkes, enhanced through strategic voluntary LGC rebalancing.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 17%减排本身有明确数据支撑，但对“operational efficiencies and technology partnerships”的归因缺乏对应量化拆分，证据无法完整覆盖全部原因表述，存在部分漂绿嫌疑。
notes: claim 自带数据，原因归因支撑不完整。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that “this year” the company achieved an approximately 17% reduction in GHG emissions and that this reduction was supported by renewable energy use, operational efficiencies, and technology partnerships. No evidence fields were provided to substantiate any part of this claim (no emissions figures, baseline and current-year values, boundary/scope, calculation basis, or documentation of renewable energy use, efficiency actions, or partnerships). As a result, the ~17% reduction and the stated supporting drivers are not verified by the provided evidence.
